verdict.rationale: Meltano docs state pipelines can be scheduled and orchestrated via Apache Airflow integration, enabling recurring job execution, and plugins/CLI support running pipelines repeatably (meltano-docs-7, meltano-docs-33). However, scheduling is not a native built-in scheduler but delegated to an external orchestrator plugin, and there's no evidence of AI-native specific triggers or agent-driven scheduling. Missing for 10: native/first-party scheduler docs, AI-agent-triggered scheduling examples, independent confirmation of scheduling reliability in production.
